agenda_text:
Lancaster Neighborhood Vitalization Commission
44933 North Fern Avenue, Lancaster, California 93534
Chairman Tim Sturtevant - Vice Chairman R. Steven Derryberry
Commissioner Bret Banks - Commissioner Larry Grooms - Commissioner Lisa Moulton
Commissioner David Sinclair - Commissioner Lew Stults
LANCASTER NEIGHBORHOOD VITALIZATION COMMISSION
AGENDA
TUESDAY
January 4, 2011
04:00 P.M.
CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
44933 Fern Avenue
Lancaster, California, 93534
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
INVOCATION
Reggie Williams, Lancaster Baptist Church
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATION : UNITE Lancaster Program - Future Business Initiative (FBI) Presentation & Recognition of Participants
PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR
This is the time for citizens who would like to address the Lancaster Neighborhood Vitalization Commission on any agendized item.
Please complete a speaker card and identify the agenda item you would like to discuss. Individual speakers are limited to three (3) minutes each.
CONSENT CALENDAR
CC 1. Approve the Lancaster Neighborhood Vitalization Commission meeting minutes of December 7, 2010.
NEW BUSINESS
NB 1. Presentation Regarding the Supplemental Security Income Program and Recommendations of the Commission to Staff - Representative(s) from the Federal Government and Contract Service Manager, Lee D’Errico
NB 2. Part 2 of an Overview of the Voucher Program - Contract Service Manager, Lee D'Errico
NB 3. Update/Report from Voucher Subcommittee to Address Potential In-House Management Issues Concerning the Voucher Program and Recommendations of the Commission to Staff - Chairman Sturtevant
NB 4. Consultants Report Regarding Management of the Voucher Program in the City of Lancaster and Recommendations of the Commission to Staff - Consultant and Contract Service Manager, Lee D'Errico
NB 5. Los Angeles Community Development Commission Presentation Concerning the Ability to Suspend Voucher Payment Assistance for Issues Involving Truancy and Recommendations of the Commission to Staff - LACDC Acting Assistant Executive Director Mr. Emilio Salas and Assisted Housing Division Manager, Tracie Mann
NB 8. Review LACDC’s Monthly Voucher Report and Recommendations of the Commission to Staff - LACDC Assisted Housing Division Manager, Tracie Mann and Contract Service Manager, Lee D’Errico
NB 6. Discussion of the Formation of a LNVC Subcommittee to meet and address the Creation of State Legislation Pertaining to Suspending Voucher Payment Assistance for Issues Involving Truancy and Report Back to the Commission
NB 7. Update/Report from the LNVC Tutoring Subcommittee Concerning a Strategy to Provide Additional Tutoring Assistance at the Trend Neighborhood Impact Home and Recommendations of the Commission to Staff - Commissioner Banks
NB 9. A Brief Discussion of Next Month’s Possible Agenda Topics - Commissioners.
PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR
We request any person who would like to address the Lancaster Neighborhood Vitalization Commission on non-agendized matters to complete a speaker card and you will find speaker cards on the back table of the Council Chambers. Additionally, we respectfully request that you fill the cards out completely and print as clearly as possible, so that if necessary, the Commission or City staff will be able to contact you either by phone or mail.
Individual speakers are limited to three (3) minutes each. When you approach the podium, please notice there are three lights. The green light comes on when you begin; the yellow light will come on when you have 30 seconds remaining and the red light will come on when your 3 minutes are up.
We ask that you be considerate of the allotted time, to allow other speakers to have their 3 minutes as well. Following this procedure will allow for a smooth and timely process for the Commission meeting and we appreciate your cooperation.
State law prohibits the Lancaster Neighborhood Vitalization Commission from taking action on items not on the agenda and your matter will be referred to staff.
ADJOURNMENT
Next meeting: February 1, 2011 - City Council Chambers
MEETING ASSISTANCE INFORMATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk Department at (661)723-6020. Services such as American Sign Language interpreters, a reader during the meeting, and/or large print copies of the agenda are available. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting.
AGENDA ADDENDUM INFORMATION
On occasion items may be added after the agenda has been mailed to subscribers. Copies of the agenda addendum item will be available at the City Clerk's Department and are posted with the agenda on the windows of the City Council Chambers. For more information, please call the City Clerk's Department at (661) 723-6020.
